found.name: Centre for Academic Success (Academic Skills)
found.quote: In upheld cases we will require you to attend sessions delivered by CAS / Academic Skills or an equivalent service as part of the case outcome.

found.name: CAS guidance on the use of AI by students
found.quote: Specific guidance on the use of AI by students has been produced by CAS and is available through Library and Learning Resources.

found.name: Students’ Union student advisor
found.quote: You have the right to take someone with you to academic misconduct meetings. This may be a student advisor from the Students’ Union or a friend or relative who is not acting in a legal capacity.
